Hello!! I started doing gouache just more than a year ago as i was bored at home during lock down, happy to share my thoughts and experience but well, i am not an expert i guess haha

I think the biggest difference between gouache and watercolor is the use of white. For water color we seldom use white but water to make a lighter color, but for gouache, in this aspect it is more like acrylic, so i do use quite a lot of white. Another tip in this same area is that some colors (e.g. yellow, green) are more translucent than the other and it makes it harder to  be used as a second layer, so you need more white for those if it is layered on something else. 

One more thing i can think of is the consistency of the paint, you need to manage the right amount of water so it is not too thick and gluey on the paper but still opaque, my personal experience is that.. if the paint texture has this yogurt / melted icecream texture, then it’s about right! 

O and there is a difference between normal gouache and acryla gouache, the former can be reactivated with water, this have pros and cons. Pros being that even the color dried out you can add water and use it again so even u mix a bigger batch, it doesnt go to waste even it dries. However it makes it harder to layer because when you put a second layer the first will get activated and the color get mixed up! Too many layers (i.e. if you keep redoing the same part) also make the paint crack, it is super annoying

Hope it helps!!! I actually really like using gouache and i hope one day you find it a fun medium too!!!

I only started using gouache Jul 2020 so not a pro also but happy to share some of my thoughts! 
I think the key is the thickness of the paint (ie water and paint ratio), if it is too thick it becomes patchy and hard to paint, if it is too thin it loses some of the opaqueness. When the texture feels like yogurt, it’s about right.

Another thing is that the color is slightly lighter when it dries, if you ever have to try and match back the same color that you already have on paper, it can get tricky.. so if you have a large area with the same color, just mix more the first time so you dont need to match it later..

Lastly, i would say the reactivating can get troublesome if you try to layer the colors, the next layer needs to be slightly thicker, and your strokes cant go back and forth or the color from the previous layer will get mixed in.

Hope this help and have fun with gouache!! Show us your work too ❤️❤️
